speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, Big T's coffin was blue.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Not dark blue. Not respectful blue. That deep candy blue you put on a car when you want other niggas to pull up beside you and hate their lives. Somebody had ordered gold handles. His picture stood at the front of the chapel, six feet tall, smiling over a room full of people who'd been scared to smile wrong around him.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Your nigga paid for all of it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The flowers. The cars. The musicians. The lunch afterward that half the guests would be too nervous to eat. T had called me son, then put a bullet in me. I couldn't make those things fit, so I bought him the biggest funeral that place could hold.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank came downstairs at the house wearing black.

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga, you ain't gotta go,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: he said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, I killed him."

speaker: TANK
text: "That's why you ain't gotta go."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I adjusted my cuff in the mirror. My hands weren't steady yet. The suit hid the bandages. The medicine made everything feel a half second farther away.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "He had nobody else?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I asked.

speaker: TANK
text: "Plenty people."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "People that loved him."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank looked toward the window.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I left the cuff alone.

speaker: TANK
text: "You did."

speaker: AIDEN
text: He kept looking out.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, you can say it."

speaker: TANK
text: "He gave me work when I came out."

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga gave me a car."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Ain't the same."

speaker: TANK
text: "I know."

speaker: AIDEN
text: For a minute we just stood there, the two men who'd left T by a swimming pool, trying to get dressed for what came after.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna came downstairs in white.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank turned.

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga, oh, hell no."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She stopped on the last stair.

speaker: AIDEN
text: White dress. White coat. White gloves in one hand. Her dark hair pinned up. Dante's watch shining like she'd polished it with her rage.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "What?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she said.

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga's funeral, Shawna."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I know whose funeral it is."

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga, you can't wear that."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She looked at me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I could've asked her to change. Could've told her this was already hard enough without her walking in looking like she'd come to get married on his grave.

speaker: AIDEN
text: But nigga, she looked beautiful.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, get the car before she decides on a veil,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I told Tank.

speaker: AIDEN
text: My nigga, nobody knew what to do when we walked in.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Some niggas stood. Some stayed seated so hard it looked like work. A woman near the front started crying louder when she saw me. I didn't know if that was grief or hate. I kept going.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna's hand was in mine.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank walked behind us.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Every nigga in that chapel knew the story had changed. T had sent me to collect a woman and some money. A week later he was in a blue box, I had his men at my back, and the woman was holding my hand in front of his face.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I didn't feel proud until somebody whispered that I shouldn't have come.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then I felt proud enough to scare myself.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Which nigga said it? Say it loud so I know who to look at,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said without turning.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nobody did.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We sat in the second row. Shawna kept her knees together and looked straight ahead. I could feel her pulse through her fingers.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The preacher talked about a generous man.

speaker: AIDEN
text: That part was true. T had been generous. He'd put money in people's hands, found rooms for niggas who had nowhere to sleep, paid somebody's mother's bill without letting anybody say thank you twice. I knew men who'd lived on that kindness for years.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The preacher talked about a man who loved his family.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna let go of my hand.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at her.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Her eyes had gone flat. She was staring at the picture, and her white glove was balled so tight in her fist I could see a seam giving way.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I put my hand on her knee. She didn't move.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then Tank got up.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He hadn't told me he planned to speak. He walked to the front carrying a folded paper, opened it, looked at it, and put it back in his pocket.

speaker: TANK
text: "T knew my mother,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: he said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: His voice sounded too big for the microphone.

speaker: TANK
text: "Knew she worried about me. Every time I came by, nigga made me call her first. Didn't matter what we was doing. Call your mother, Tank. Tell her you ate."

speaker: AIDEN
text: A woman near the aisle laughed through her crying.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank looked at the coffin.

speaker: TANK
text: "She died while I was inside. T paid for everything. Told me don't owe him for that."

speaker: AIDEN
text: He rubbed one hand down the front of his suit.

speaker: TANK
text: "I owed him for it anyway."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I could hear Shawna breathing beside me.

speaker: TANK
text: "He did some shit,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The preacher shifted.

speaker: TANK
text: "Some shit I can't stand up here and fix for him. I ain't gonna try. But he picked me up when nobody was answering. And I remember that."

speaker: AIDEN
text: He stepped away from the microphone.

speaker: AIDEN
text: On the way back, he looked at me once.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I nodded.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, it hurt. I needed to let it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Red had sent flowers taller than the coffin.

speaker: AIDEN
text: White roses, blue ribbon, his name on a card big enough to read from the aisle. He hadn't come himself. Every time the door opened, your nigga looked. I hated that he could make me wait for him at a dead man's funeral.

speaker: AIDEN
text: When people went up to the coffin, Shawna stayed seated.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You don't have to,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I know."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then she stood.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We walked up together.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T lay there wearing a dark suit and the ring that had cut my mouth. Somebody had made him look peaceful. I remembered him saying he'd made me. I remembered being happy when he said son.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, a dead man shouldn't be able to embarrass you. But I stood over him ashamed of how much I'd wanted him to mean it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna put a folded photograph on his chest.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I recognized the chapel in the background. Her wedding. Dante smiling with his arms around her. This was another print, with T still visible at the edge, one hand on his brother's shoulder.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You can take your fucking picture with you,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she whispered.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I thought she was done.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then she bent close.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "He loved you. You knew he did."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Her voice broke on loved.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked away before she saw me watching.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Behind us, the preacher cleared his throat. I wanted to turn around and tell that nigga to swallow it. Let her have a minute. Let her tell one dead man what the other couldn't hear.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna straightened.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I touched T's cuff once. I don't know why. Maybe because I couldn't touch his hand. Maybe because he'd never get to pull me close again, and some stupid little part of me wanted that settled properly.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, all you had to do was let us go,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then I took my woman's hand and walked out.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Outside, Rosa waited beside the cars in black sunglasses and a coat the wind kept trying to take.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She'd come for Shawna. She said that three times to everybody who asked.

speaker: ROSA
text: "I ain't crying for that nigga,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she told me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nobody asked you to."

speaker: ROSA
text: "I know. I just want the dead to be clear."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna leaned against her. Rosa wrapped the coat around both of them and let her stay there while the pallbearers brought the coffin down.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Mercedes and Porsche stood by the Mercedes with a tray of sandwiches between them. They'd come dressed for church and carrying enough food to keep a war from becoming rude. Leon had sent a new white Bentley with them because, according to the card, seeing the last one die had changed his feelings about ownership.

speaker: TANK
text: "That's love,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank said, taking two sandwiches.

speaker: PORSCHE
text: "That's a nigga with insurance,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Porsche told him.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I saw the black SUV before the first shot. It came around the chapel too slowly. There was another one behind it. Both had dark windows. Both had men leaning forward as if whatever they wanted was about to become available.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank stopped chewing.

speaker: TANK
text: "Down."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The first bullet shattered the tray in Porsche's hands.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I caught Shawna around the waist and drove us behind the Mercedes. Rosa hit the ground beside us. Somebody screamed. Gunfire ripped through the chapel doors, and the beautiful blue sky filled with glass.

speaker: AIDEN
text: A pallbearer dropped beside the hearse. Rico. Thirty-two. I'd learned his name that morning because he'd told me the gold cuff links were a gift from his daughter, who was grown and living in another state, and he'd wanted me to notice she had taste.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He wasn't moving.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank fired over the hood. The sound went through my chest. Porsche pulled Mercedes down behind the rear wheel as another burst took the car's mirror off.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Everybody inside!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I shouted.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The chapel doors were open, but the drive between us and them was full of bullets. A woman stood frozen halfway down the steps holding the hand of her seventy-year-old husband. He was trying to pull her down. She kept looking at Rico.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, get her!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I shouted to Tank.

speaker: TANK
text: "You stay here!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I heard you the first time!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: He ran bent low across the drive. Shots tore the flowers off a standing wreath behind him. He caught the old man under one arm and pushed the woman ahead of him through the doors. The whole front of the chapel swallowed them.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The first SUV came farther into the lot. Its passenger leaned out with a gun.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I fired from beside the wheel. The man jerked back inside. The SUV clipped the fountain, turned, and struck the empty wheelchair someone had left for me at the bottom of the steps.

speaker: AIDEN
text: That pissed me off personally.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "That nigga just hit my chair."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna had her pistol out. She fired twice toward the second SUV and pulled back beside me.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You weren't using it."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Still mine."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Across the drive, the hearse began rolling.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Its driver was on the ground behind the open door. I couldn't tell whether he was hurt or scared. The engine was running. The car moved forward, slow at first, down the slight slope toward the street. T's coffin gleamed inside it through the rear window.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The first SUV turned to follow it.

speaker: ROSA
text: "They're taking him,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Rosa said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Taking who?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: For one second I couldn't believe any nigga alive had found a way to complicate that man's death further.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then I saw the shooter get out of the SUV and run toward the driver's door of the hearse.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna grabbed my jacket.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Aiden."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "They don't get him."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Baby, he's dead."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then he ain't driving himself home."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I kissed her once and went.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The driveway tilted under me. Pain shot across my ribs. Somebody shouted my name from the chapel doors, and somebody else shouted,

speaker: B01C05_CHAPEL_ONLOOKER
text: "Look at that nigga,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: like the first person had been announcing a miracle and the second wanted everybody to see it before it left.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I hit the hearse as the gunman reached it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He had one hand on the wheel. I caught his jacket and drove him against the open door. His gun went off into the sky. We slammed into the side of the moving car, my shoulder against the window, his elbow against my throat.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He was bigger than me and healthy. Nigga, that was his whole fucking argument.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I put my forehead into his nose.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He fell back. I shoved him clear and jumped into the driver's seat. The hearse hit the curb with both front wheels. Behind me T's coffin thumped against its restraints like the nigga had an opinion.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You can shut up too,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I told him.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The first SUV came after us.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I drove the hearse through the open cemetery gate across the road. Gravel burst beneath the tires. White stones flashed past on both sides. I kept to the broad center drive, flying between the trees while the men behind me fired through their own windshield.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The hearse's rear glass shattered. A gold handle on the coffin caught the light.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, they're scratching your box."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I turned hard around the stone circle at the center of the cemetery. The hearse leaned. The coffin stayed where it was. I could hear the SUV behind us lose its grip on the gravel, tires screaming while its driver tried to copy a man who was presently doing the best driving at his own enemy's funeral.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We came out beside a second gate. A groundskeeper stood next to a watering truck, hose in his hand, mouth open. I lifted two fingers. He dropped the hose and lifted two back.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Respect knew what to do even when nothing else did.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I took the hearse onto the service road. The SUV followed, front bumper bent, one headlight gone. A second engine roared somewhere ahead of us.

speaker: AIDEN
text: For a second I thought they'd boxed me in.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then the white Bentley appeared across the intersection with Shawna driving.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Her coat was off. Her white gloves were on. Porsche sat beside her holding her purse against the dash and grinning like she'd just gotten invited to the best part of her own fucking life.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna turned the Bentley toward the SUV.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Baby, don't—"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Too late. She struck its front corner and knocked it sideways across the road. The Bentley spun, white smoke pouring off the tires. Porsche's door flew open and slammed shut again. The SUV climbed the curb and hit a stone wall hard enough to throw its hood up like a surrender flag.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I braked the hearse beside them.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna looked through her broken window at me.

speaker: PORSCHE
text: "Nigga, your wife drives too."

speaker: AIDEN
text: We weren't married. I didn't correct her. I was busy falling in love with her for the fourth fucking time before lunch.

speaker: AIDEN
text: A man came out of the SUV with a gun.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I fired through the hearse's open door. He dropped behind the engine and his weapon clattered into the gutter. Another man tried to pull him back inside. Tank's Mercedes arrived from the far end of the road, and that nigga took one look at Tank getting out and raised both hands so high I thought he was asking God to pull him through the sunroof.

speaker: TANK
text: "Who sent you?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank shouted.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The man didn't answer.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank took another step.

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga, this is the easy question."

speaker: B01C05_ATTACKER
text: "T had friends!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I got out of the hearse.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then where the fuck were you when they passed the collection plate?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: The man's eyes widened. He looked from me to the coffin behind the shattered rear window.

speaker: B01C05_ATTACKER
text: "You killed him."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "And I'm burying him. You coming between those things again, you can ask him how he feels about it yourself."

speaker: AIDEN
text: He stared at the pistol in my hand. Then at the blood beginning to show through my shirt. Then at Shawna stepping out of the Bentley in a white dress with glass shining around her shoes.

speaker: B01C05_ATTACKER
text: "You don't stop,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: he said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: It came out almost admiring. Like he'd found the problem and hated that it was beautiful.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, you should've asked somebody before you came."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Knox's cruisers arrived behind Tank. I hadn't called her. Half the city had. Men got put on the ground, guns got kicked away, and the chief got out with her eyes already on me.

speaker: GLORIA_KNOX
text: "Please tell me that's an empty hearse."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Family in the back."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She looked through the window.

speaker: GLORIA_KNOX
text: "You brought the deceased into a pursuit?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga wasn't walking."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Knox took off her glasses.

speaker: AIDEN
text: For three seconds I watched her try to decide whether she'd seen anything better in thirty years of police work.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then she laughed. Loud. Hands on her hips, face turned toward the sky, laughing while the men in handcuffs looked at her like she had personally betrayed the law by appreciating me.

speaker: GLORIA_KNOX
text: "Aiden,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she said,

speaker: GLORIA_KNOX
text: "you are wasting your fucking talents in civilian clothes."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You keep saying that."

speaker: GLORIA_KNOX
text: "I'm going to keep saying it until somebody gives me what I want."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna reached me. She had a shallow cut on her hand, nothing worse, and I kissed it before she could tell me the blood wasn't all hers.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I asked you to stay with the car,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I did. I moved the car."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Porsche came around the Bentley and held out its keys to Tank.

speaker: PORSCHE
text: "Tell Leon this one had a meaningful life too."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank looked at the crushed front fender.

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga gonna start sending bicycles."

speaker: AIDEN
text: We brought T back to the chapel in the same hearse, with a police escort in front and Shawna in the seat beside me. People came out when they heard the engines. Somebody started applauding. A woman on the steps raised both hands and shouted my name so hard her hat moved.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I got out slowly. My side had finally started collecting everything I owed it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The old man Tank had rescued came down the steps with his wife. She put both hands around my face.

speaker: B01C05_RESCUED_WOMAN
text: "You brought everybody home."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked past her at the white sheet beside the curb.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Not everybody.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Rico was still there. Vernon, forty-one, had died inside the chapel after they carried him in. Two of my people gone while I was trying to keep one dead man from being taken again.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I held the woman's hands for a second, then let them go.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Help me finish this,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I told Tank.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We put our hands on T's blue coffin. Four other men came beside us. The funeral workers found their places. The musicians began the hymn again, shaky at first, then strong enough that the whole parking lot listened.

speaker: AIDEN
text: This time when we carried him to the waiting car, nobody stopped us.

speaker: AIDEN
text: They buried T later that afternoon.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I didn't go to the graveside. Vega was back at the house, furious enough that everybody found a reason to leave the room when she walked in. She examined me behind closed doors while Shawna sat on the bed, still in the dirty white dress.

speaker: DR_VEGA
text: "You were told to rest,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Vega said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I was sitting at a funeral."

speaker: DR_VEGA
text: "You are bleeding in a house full of armed men. I am interested in what happened after the sitting."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked away.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She made arrangements for what I needed, repeated herself slowly enough to insult me, and left with the promise that I was going back under her care if my condition worsened. I believed her. So did Shawna. That meant I was trapped in my own fucking palace.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Two of our men were dead. Others were hurt. Tank told me their names and made me repeat them. I said I'd pay for everything. He said their mothers needed to hear a human being first.

speaker: AIDEN
text: So I called.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, there wasn't a thing on earth I could say that made that conversation right. I didn't try to make a speech. I told them who I was. Told them I was sorry. Stayed on the line through whatever they needed to call me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: When I finished, I threw the phone across the room.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna watched it hit the wall.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I want Red,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You don't know it was him."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Who the fuck else, Shawna?"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "People loved T."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, I paid for the funeral."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You also killed him."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I hated hearing it in her voice. Hated that she could say something true while I wanted her angry beside her nigga.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You defending Red now?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Her face went cold.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Say that again."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I didn't.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She stood up, took Dante's watch off, and set it beside me on the bed.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You think I forgot what those men did?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: The watch lay face up between us.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You think because I got a house and some fucking earrings I forgot where they left him?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "No."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Then don't talk to me like I'm sleeping through this."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She picked it back up. Her fingers were shaking at the clasp. I reached for her hand, and she let me help her fasten it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I'm scared,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She looked at me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, I'd rather have taken another punch than said that. But I'd seen her under that car, and I couldn't get the glass out of my head.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I'm scared they get you while I'm laying here."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She sat down.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Then stop trying to stand up every time somebody says your name."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I put my forehead against hers.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Outside the room, Rosa was yelling at Tank to eat something. He told her he wasn't hungry. She told him she hadn't asked for his fucking feelings about the sandwich.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna laughed once, through her nose.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I held on to her.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Red's invitation came at sunset.

speaker: AIDEN
text: A man from the Saint left a black envelope at the gate. Tank brought it upstairs on a silver tray he must've taken from the kitchen. I stared at it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, why you serving me a threat?"

speaker: TANK
text: "Didn't wanna touch it more than I had to."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I took the envelope.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Inside was an invitation printed in gold. Breakfast at the Saint. Tomorrow morning. Penthouse. My name and Shawna's, together like we were anybody's idea of welcome guests.

speaker: AIDEN
text: There was another card behind it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I read it once.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then I gave it to Shawna.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She sat on the bed so suddenly I thought her legs had gone.

speaker: TANK
text: "What?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She didn't answer. She was staring at the handwriting. I watched her thumb move to Dante's watch and stay there.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Red had written one sentence.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Dante didn't die for three million.
